notes.semetey-1-2013:p0152:b004:l020: Self-deprecating recollection of leaving her father in tears after the Aktulpar dispute, while Manas was still alive. Unfortunate avoids both moral shamelessness and anachronistic widowhood. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json.
